title: Adaptable Watermarking: Transforming Image Watermarking Models via Lightweight Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2611.18363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We explore the adaptability of neural image watermarking models; the extent to which one watermarking method can be transformed into another through lightweight adaptation. We introduce a framework that enables encoder-decoder watermarking architectures to become modular and upgradable, supporting multiple watermarking styles without re-training full models. Adaptation is performed by attaching a compact parameter-efficient adapter and fine-tuning under a multi-domain residual alignment loss (spatial, gradient, and frequency) while preserving bit accuracy via a secret-loss term. We evaluate this approach across a suite of recent watermarking models, including TrustMark, InvisMark, RoSteALS, HiDDeN, and WAM, demonstrating that adapted encoders closely reproduce target residuals and that adapted decoders recover messages with near-optimal accuracy under standard augmentations and distortions. translated_title: 适应性水印：通过轻量级适配器转换图像水印模型
translated_abstract: 我们探索了神经图像水印模型的适应性，即一种水印方法通过轻量级适配被转换为另一种方法的程度。我们提出了一个框架，使编码器-解码器水印架构变得模块化和可升级，无需重新训练完整模型即可支持多种水印风格。适配通过附加一个紧凑的参数高效适配器，并在多域残差对齐损失（空间域、梯度域和频域）下进行微调来实现，同时通过秘密损失项保持比特准确性。我们在一系列近期水印模型上评估了这种方法，包括TrustMark、InvisMark、RoSteALS、HiDDeN和WAM，证明了适配后的编码器能够紧密再现目标残差，且适配后的解码器在标准增强和失真条件下能以接近最优的准确性恢复消息。
tldr: 提出了一个通过轻量级参数高效适配器和多域残差对齐损失，将现有图像水印模型转换为其他水印方法的框架，无需重新训练完整模型即可实现模块化和可升级的水印架构。
en_tdlr: Proposes a framework that transforms existing image watermarking models into other watermarking methods using lightweight parameter-efficient adapters and multi-domain residual alignment losses, enabling modular and upgradable watermarking architectures without full model re-training.
